mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_refund_callback(tenant_id,callback_no,refund_no,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_event_id,merchant_refund_no, observation_kind,provider_transaction_no,provider_refund_no,amount,currency,occurred_at,payload_hash,fact_hash,payload_cipher,key_version,signature_version, status,received_at,created_at,updated_at,business_no) VALUES(#{tenant},#{number},#{refund},#{code},#{merchant},#{event},#{request}, #{kind},#{transaction},#{providerRefund},#{amount},#{currency},#{paid},#{payloadHash},#{factHash},#{cipher},#{keyVersion},#{signature}, 'PENDING',#{now},#{now},#{now},#{businessNo}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=tc_refund_callback.id
mapper.select: SELECT id,callback_no,refund_no,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_event_id,merchant_refund_no,observation_kind,provider_transaction_no,provider_refund_no,amount,currency,occurred_at,payload_hash,fact_hash,payload_cipher,key_version,signature_version,status,received_at,processed_at,last_error FROM tc_refund_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND channel_code=#{code} AND channel_merchant_no=#{merchant} AND provider_event_id=#{event} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id,callback_no,refund_no,channel_code,channel_merchant_no,provider_event_id,merchant_refund_no,observation_kind,provider_transaction_no,provider_refund_no,amount,currency,occurred_at,payload_hash,fact_hash,payload_cipher,key_version,signature_version,status,received_at,processed_at,last_error FROM tc_refund_callback WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND callback_no=#{number}
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_refund_callback SET status='PROCESSED',processed_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),last_error=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND callback_no=#{number} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE tc_refund_callback SET status='REVIEW',last_error=#{error},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND callback_no=#{number} AND status='PENDING'
